corpora.title: FHIR/fhir-test-cases, the shared cross-implementation FHIR test corpus

documents.note: spec-clean tier: MedicationRequest with its 1..1 subject
spec-clean tier: decimal precision on a non-vital-sign lab LOINC
spec-clean tier: a lab Observation with a reference range
spec-clean tier: the vital-signs profile's mandatory elements
spec-clean tier: a base Patient carrying every element the base spec requires
quirk tier: misaligned primitive-extension sibling, the reader fails closed
quirk tier: resourceType is not the first property
quirk tier: exponent-notation decimal, precision preserved
quirk tier: searchset Bundle with link[relation=next]
quirk tier: US Core race + birthsex on a base Patient

documents.exclude: deliberately invalid corpus fixture: the corpus ships it as a negative case and it omits Bundle.type, which R4 makes 1..1 (bundle.html). The oracle errors on it by construction, so it is evidence about the corpus rather than about agreement.
